title: Login fails when password contains special characters
body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Register a user with password 'p@ss!w0rd#'.
2. Try to log in.
3. Login returns 401 even though credentials are correct.

Expected: login succeeds.
Observed: 401 Unauthorized.

We think the bug is in src/auth/login.py — the password is being URL-decoded twice, which mangles special characters.
author: HuyTK
